acceptance_tests: The proposal fingerprint, every declared Tide Pit input, original Gills files, shared Mutable package, and authenticated JUCE source pass readiness authentication before plug-in implementation.
Exactly sixteen adapter parameters have unique stable IDs, exact source domains, defaults, quantization, complete mapping, and a frozen contract fingerprint.
Versioned state applies only after complete schema, fingerprint, ID, cardinality, finite-value, and range validation and rejects malformed bytes without partial mutation.
State recall creates a fresh Core, restores continuous and persistent desired mode state through existing source gestures, and never replays Mutate or Freeze or claims evolving-state restoration.

At 48000 Hz the processor and direct Core plus Q27HostBridge paths match exactly for controls, timestamped channel-16 CC events, one-shots, mode reconciliation, recall, and declared host block partitions.

Unsupported rates and layouts produce deterministic silence, overflow is bounded and counted, and repeated processing performs no adapter-owned heap, lock, file, endpoint, paint, JSON, or unbounded callback work.
Two instances remain independent and deterministic, and editor creation and destruction open no endpoint and inject no duplicate event.

The Release arm64 VST3 exposes one zero-input stereo-output MIDI instrument, scans and instantiates in a separate JUCE VST3 host, round-trips state, creates and destroys its editor, and renders the expected nonzero fixture.
Existing Tide Pit source, Core, control, UI, MIDI, render, and standalone checks, Schuss current, and one relocated VST3 reproduction pass after freeze.
Results keep source, host structural, host signal, target build, real-time, Live, connected-device, listening, distribution, and production evidence independent.

may: Choose prototype-local VST3 codes, bundle and target names, sixteen stable adapter parameter IDs, state schema, processor and editor classes, fixed capacities, fixtures, dimensions, and bounded error presentation.
Represent Source, Lock, FX Mode, Target, and Scale as desired persistent VST values reconciled only through the existing Tide Pit gestures, while Mutate and Freeze remain one-shots.
Add the smallest direct processor, allocation, module-host, receipt, and relocation evidence needed by this contract.
must_not: Change Tide Pit DSP equations, defaults, scales, random state law, source gestures, controller semantics, source dependencies, retained standalone evidence, or original source oracle.
Create or imply a canonical JUCE provider, implementation binding, runtime, package, distribution approval, real-time result, Live result, device result, listening result, or production promotion.
Mutate configured upstream or JUCE trees, inherited Pamplist or Layerwell work, install or copy the plug-in, launch an application, open endpoints, access hardware, or alter Git or publication state.

deliverables: Frozen Task 046 proposal and ready source-reimplementation bundle under research/prototypes/tide-pit-gills/contract-vst3-r01.
JUCE-independent stable sixteen-parameter program model with exhaustive focused tests.
Isolated JUCE VST3 processor, accepted-state editor, factory entry, versioned state seam, direct processor tests, allocation probe, and separate module-host tests.
Opt-in authenticated CMake VST3 target with source fetching and copy-after-build installation disabled.
Release arm64 Tide Pit.vst3 retained only in a build directory with portable build receipt, results, gaps, affected regressions, current result, and one relocated reproduction.
dependency_contracts: The six original Gills Tide Pit files must match source-equivalence.json at runtime and remain read-only.
The current Tide Pit portable Core, host bridge, controller map, UI model, source lock, and original proposal fingerprints in the approved proposal remain the normative Schuss implementation input.
The shared mutable-ksoloti-v1 package must authenticate at package revision 1 and remain unmodified.
JUCE 8.0.15 must be supplied as an authenticated local source tree; fetching, source mutation, and installation are disabled by default.

goal.primary_claim: At exactly 48000 Hz, the private arm64 VST3 host adapter preserves the frozen Tide Pit Core's continuous controls, source actions, desired persistent modes, fresh-recall rule, timestamped MIDI, and stereo signal behavior across arbitrary positive host block partitions.
goal.why: Running Tide Pit directly in Ableton removes the separate-process routing step and makes private recording, freezing, resampling, layering, automation, and multi-instance use practical without redesigning the instrument.
